title: YourTal principal attributes
description: Every attribute the PDP is allowed to reason about. additionalProperties is false on purpose: a typo in a caller's attribute name must fail loudly in CI, not silently produce a DENY that looks like a policy bug. See policies/README.md.

jurisdiction.description: Where this principal is governed. Drives nothing in these policies yet; the jurisdiction policy service (YT-0037) owns feature switches.

businessRoles.description: businessId -> role held at THAT business. A person can be owner of one business and analyst of another, which a flat role list cannot express. This map is the whole multi-tenancy model; derived_roles/business.yaml reads it and nothing else does.

isSuspended.description: Risk has suspended this principal. Every value-moving action is denied while true.

hasPasskey.description: docs/14 section 5: a registered passkey is required before the first redemption above a value threshold.

reauthenticatedAt.description: RFC3339. Step-up re-auth timestamp. Ownership transfer requires this to be recent; see STEP_UP_WINDOW in derived_roles/business.yaml.

valueFrozenUntil.description: RFC3339. SIM-swap / account-recovery freeze (docs/14 section 5). Redemption and transfer are denied until it passes.

deviceBusinessId.description: store_device only: the business this device was provisioned for. Never inferred from the request.

deviceLocationId.description: store_device only: the location it was bound to (docs/17 section 2.2, "Kemang counter 2").

goodwillCreditCeilingIdr.description: support only: the per-case ceiling below which a goodwill credit needs no second approver.
